name: Azure DevOps
description: Connect an Azure DevOps organization to list its Git repositories.

methods.label: Sign in with Microsoft Entra ID
methods.whenToUse: Use delegated Microsoft Entra access for an organization backed by Microsoft Entra ID.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in with the Microsoft Entra account that can access the Azure DevOps organization, then enter its organization name. This connection action only lists repository metadata and needs Code (Read).

tenantFields.label: Organization
tenantFields.helperMd: Enter the organization name from https://dev.azure.com/{organization}.

methods.label: Use a personal access token
methods.whenToUse: Use a personal access token when delegated sign-in is unavailable.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a short-lived Azure DevOps personal access token with Code (Read) permission, enter it below, and provide the organization name. This connection action only lists repository metadata. Prefer Microsoft Entra sign-in when your organization supports it.

credentialFields.label: Azure DevOps personal access token
credentialFields.helperMd: Create a short-lived personal access token with Code (Read) only. Azure DevOps organization policies may restrict PAT creation, permissions, or lifetime; Paperclip cannot increase an existing token's permissions.

tenantFields.label: Organization
tenantFields.helperMd: Enter the organization name from https://dev.azure.com/{organization}.

warnings: Personal access tokens are bearer credentials. Create a short-lived token with Code (Read) only and share the connection only with trusted agents.
